summary: Iteration 17 features (break-even+fees lock, maker post-only entries w/ market fallback, maker_entries config, 24h log API, UI fixes). Backend: 34/34 pytest pass (new test_iteration17_fee_lock_ui.py 14 tests + it16/it15/it8 regression 20). Maker path tested with fake ccxt only, no real orders. Frontend: title, password eye toggle, header without chat/help, chat/help inside Settings, full-screen 24h log + filters (checked with seeded logs: ALL4/BUY1/SELL1/FILLS3/HOLD2, >24h row left out), footer-info-link -> /info/capabilities with centered tabs, info-tab-pricing navigation, boot screen logo (caught live: img alt 'Frasberg AI · Luchii', no BOOTING text in src), mobile 390px with no horizontal overflow. One UX gap: the maker toggle is hidden for the default LUCHII_003 strategy.

minor.issue: Possible double buy. After the 20s wait, if cancel_order raises because the limit filled at that moment, the except swallows it and returns None. market_order then places a market BUY too, so the position can end up 2x size. Fix: on cancel failure, re-fetch the order and return it with maker True if it filled, and only fall back to market when filled == 0.

On a partial maker fill the order comes back with partial_maker and the unfilled rest is never bought. The position is smaller than sized. This may be acceptable but it is not logged as a reduced size.

maker_buy waits inside execute() for up to 20s per asset, polling every 2s. If the tick loop awaits execute in sequence, other assets' exits/stops are delayed by up to 20s while a maker entry is pending.

peak_move >= fee_rt + 0.1 has no epsilon. With peak exactly entry*1.0032, (100.32-100)/100*100 = 0.31999... and the lock does not arm in protective_stop. The TP check uses -1e-9, so use the same epsilon here.

When maker_entries fills as maker, fee_rate stays the taker rate, so the break-even floor and TP stay conservative (slightly over-estimated). Not a bug, but the 'lower fee' benefit is not reflected in the targets.

The lockout key uses request.client.host, which behind the k8s ingress is the proxy/pod IP, not the user. 6 bad attempts gave 401 x6 and no 429, so brute-force lockout is not effective in preview. Use the X-Forwarded-For first hop or key on email only.

ui_bugs.issue: maker-entries-toggle only renders when strategy=AGGRESSIVE SCALP (it sits inside {!luchii && ...}). engine.execute applies maker_entries to every live BUY, including LUCHII_003, the default strategy. So LUCHII_003 users cannot see or turn off maker entries. Move the toggle outside the !luchii block.

issues: The trailing-stop help text ('With trailing on, the stop-loss % is measured from the highest price...') now sits under the maker toggle, away from the trailing toggle it describes.
The first row gets the animate-flash-in amber highlight in full-screen mode, so it looks selected.
13 tabs wrap into about 8 rows and push the content below the fold. A horizontal scroll strip or a select would be better. No overflow.

action_items: Fix the maker_buy cancel-race double-buy: on cancel exception, fetch the order and return it if filled > 0. Never fall through to a market buy when the limit may have filled.
Show maker-entries-toggle for the LUCHII_003 strategy too, or skip maker for luchii003 in execute.
Add an epsilon (-1e-9) to the break-even threshold comparison in signal() and protective_stop().
Optional: run the maker wait off the main tick path (or shorten it) so other assets' exits are not blocked.
Optional (pre-existing): base the login lockout identifier on the forwarded client IP or the email.
critical_code_review_comments: exchange_service.maker_buy swallows all exceptions around cancel/fetch, which can cause a duplicate market order (see above).
SettingsModal.jsx is 536 lines and close to the 700-line limit. Consider splitting the tabs into separate files.

The break-even lock only exists in the aggressive signal() path. LUCHII_003 relies on strategy.evaluate's own break-even logic. Confirm it is the intended behaviour for 'winner never turns into a net loss'.

rca of the issue: Double-buy risk: maker_buy line ~208-215. try: cancel_order; fetch_order ... except: pass; return None. If the post-only limit fills between the last poll and the cancel, OKX rejects the cancel (order already filled), the exception is swallowed, None is returned, and market_order then creates a market buy. Mitigation: always fetch_order after a cancel attempt, in its own try block, and return it with maker True if filled > 0.
